answer_1.quote: We comprehensively evaluate the utility preservation of IAM from four kinds of scenarios: 1) Language modeling: we measure the perplexity on WikiText-v2. 2) Language understanding: We evaluate performance on the MMLU. 3) QA task: we assess QA performance using the HotpotQA dataset and adopt F1 score as evaluation metric. 4) Long context: we utilize Gov-Report benchmark to test the long text summarization capacity.
answer_1.outputs: Generated continuations, answers, and summaries produced by the large language model.
